description: This file defines an interface ClientMapper that uses MapStruct to map Client domain objects to ClientData transfer objects with various customized mappings and helper methods for converting domain enums and codes to data transfer representations.

classes.name: ClientMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting Client domain objects into ClientData DTOs with customized property mappings and helper methods for enum/code conversion.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a Client object into a ClientData transfer object, applying customized mappings for various fields.

methods.name: clientTypeCode
methods.description: Converts a client's clientType CodeValue into a CodeValueData object for transfer.

methods.name: clientClassificationCode
methods.description: Converts a client's clientClassification CodeValue into a CodeValueData object for transfer.

methods.name: clientSubStatusCode
methods.description: Converts a client's subStatus CodeValue into a CodeValueData object for transfer.

methods.name: clientGenderCode
methods.description: Converts a client's gender CodeValue into a CodeValueData object for transfer.

methods.name: clientLegalFormEnum
methods.description: Provides an EnumOptionData for the client's legalForm enumeration.

methods.name: clientStatusEnum
methods.description: Provides an EnumOptionData for the client's status enumeration.

methods.name: clientTimelineData
methods.description: Creates a ClientTimelineData object based on the client's current status and key dates/actors.

methods.name: clientIsStaff
methods.description: Returns a Boolean representing if the client is a staff member.
